title: Swap and sort three
description:
Use pointers to change variables in the caller.

```
Before: 9 2 5
After:  2 5 9
min 2 and max 9 found in one call
```
hints: Inside `swap`, `*a` is the caller's variable: `int t = *a; *a = *b; *b = t;` (lesson 3.03).
Three compare-and-swaps sort three values: (a, b), (b, c), then (a, b) again.
requirements: `void min_max(const int *values, int n, int *min, int *max)` returns two results through pointers.
stretch: Write `void rotate3(int *a, int *b, int *c)` that moves each value one place along.
